comparison.objective: Move an adjustable-dumbbell selector, lift with both weight pairs attached, return, and release; the candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Selector extraction/insertion and load-bearing functional test, not concentric threaded countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Selector remains near the lower slot, weights lift together, and all bodies return with final low contact; candidate instead verifies a jam-nut-locked angle over cycles.
comparison.reason: Both adjust then function-test equipment, but the adjustable mechanisms and required manipulation abilities are materially different across all three versions.
